summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @hubsync/web-sdk-react@6.3.22 declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js` — a 727KB @bun-cjs file heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotated string array with a push/shift rotator, hex-mangled identifiers, numeric constant table feeding a character-table decoder). The payload runs under a freshly fetched alternate runtime rather than the installer's Node, avoiding normal Node-based inspection, and fires automatically on `npm install` with the installer's user privileges. The package.json `description` is `Verdocs Web SDK for React` and dist/ code references verdocs.com API endpoints (api.verdocs.com, beta.verdocs.com, stage-api.verdocs.com), while the package is published under the unrelated `@hubsync` scope — a rehost of the Verdocs SDK content with an install-time dropper added. A React SDK has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundled blob.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
